newsitem.title: USA: Air Products cites "robust" equipment area.
newsitem.headline: Air Products cites "robust" equipment area.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said on Tuesday that a strong equipment segment was partially responsible for its 13-percent increase in net operating income for the second quarter ending March 31.

"The quarter's growth was driven by broad-based productivity gains in our domestic gases business, a robust equipment segment, continued progress in loading our tonnage hudrogen plants and our additional pownerhsip in Carburos Metalicos," Chairman H.A. Wagner said in a statement.
Air Products reported quarterly net operating income of $0.96 per share, compared to $0.85 for the same period a year ago.
Wagner said the company "will continue to pursue top-line sales growth in our worldwide gases and chemicals businesses," while aggressively managing its cost structure.
